verdict.rationale: LiveKit is an API-driven platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of versioned APIs or of any deprecation policy. The deployment rollback items (livekit-docs-15, livekit-docs-27) cover agent deployment versions, and the separate Protocol project (livekit-comm-5) is a protobuf reference; both are adjacent features, not versioned APIs with a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
